section_1_nand_2025_2026_h2.summary: 2025 saw Samsung V10 400+L, Kioxia BiCS9 256L, YMTC Xtacking 4.0 267L HVM ramp. 2026-H2 added BiCS10 332L sampling (2026-07-03), YMTC IPO (H1 2027 listing target), Samsung V10 mass production August 2026, V11 500+L trial production. HBF-aware NAND (Sandisk HBF + Samsung zNAND-O) defined as a new tier between HBM and SSD.

section_2_dram_hbm_2025_2026_h2.summary: HBM4 (12-Hi 36GB) mass production across SK hynix (2025-09-12 dev done → 2025-Q4 / 2026 H1 ramp), Samsung (2025-Q4), Micron (Q1 2026 calendar). HBM4E (12-Hi 48GB 16 Gbps) sampling: Samsung 2026-05-29 (industry-first), SK hynix 2026-06-17. JEDEC JESD209-6 LPDDR6 (2025-07-09) + ISSCC 2026 silicon from Samsung & SK hynix. JEDEC JESD330-4 SPHBM4 (June 2026). JEDEC HBM5 in development.

jedec_standards_2025_2026.spec: 8 Gb/s pin × 2,048-bit = up to 2 TB/s; 32 channels (64 pseudo); 4-Hi/8-Hi/12-Hi/16-Hi; 24 Gb / 32 Gb die; max cube 64 GB

section_3_emerging_memory_2025_2026_h2.summary: MRAM: Samsung 8nm (2026 target) + 5nm (2026-06 VLSI Symposium reveal); TSMC 16nm MRAM ready / 12nm development / 5nm MRAM for Europe automotive (2025-05); Avalanche 22nm Gen3 production at UMC (2022-09, ongoing). ReRAM: Weebit FY25 revenue $4.4M AUD (~ $3.7M USD, 4× YoY); onsemi integration tape-out 2025-10; CrossBar DARIC SPU demo 2025-10. FeFET/FeRAM: TSMC IEDM 2025 OS-FeFET 0.009 µm²; CXMT IEDM 2025 FeRAM; Samsung IGZO FeFET IEDM 2025; FMC €100M raise 2025; Ramxeed rebrand 2025-01 + RAMXEED ULTIMATE 10-year retention 2026-08-07. HBF: Sandisk Gen1 1.6 TB/s (2026-Q3 samples) / Gen2 2 TB/s / Gen3 3.2 TB/s (2027). PCM: Optane 停产; SK hynix SOM with OTS for CXL. CNT: Nantero defunct 2024; Ramxeed no active product.

section_4_manufacturing_2025_2026_h2.summary: TSMC CoWoS 100-130K wpm EoY 2026 target; Q1 2026 actual ~38K wpm; lead times 52-78 weeks; NVIDIA ~60% / ~595K wafers; 85%+ 2026-2027 capacity pre-booked. TSMC SoIC 6µm HVM Feb 2026; 3µm 2027 → revised to 4.5µm A14-on-A14 SoIC 2029 (per 2026 NA Tech Symposium). AMD Zen 6 (Venice) server launch 2026-07-23; Zen 5 3D V-Cache Gen2 (96 MB total L3 per CCD); Zen 6 Gen3 rumored 144 MB per CCD. Intel Panther Lake (Core Ultra Series 3) = first 18A client SoC, ramping 2025, broad market Jan 2026. Foveros Direct Gen2 3µm planned 18A-PT H2 2026. Samsung 4nm logic die for HBM4. SK hynix 1bnm DRAM for HBM4. Micron 1-gamma DRAM for HBM4E 2027. Samsung X-Cube 7nm (2024) → 4nm (2026 H1).
